operations.name: init-snapshot-upload
operations.summary: Start a snapshot upload (replaces all data of a file data source); returns jobId and presigned upload URLs (SINGLE up to 100MB, MULTIPART above)

operations.name: complete-snapshot-upload
operations.summary: Complete a snapshot upload after the file was uploaded to the presigned URL(s)

fields.name: partETags
fields.description: Part ETags in partNumber order (multipart upload only)

operations.name: get-ingest-job
operations.summary: Show an ingest job's status and statistics

operations.name: enable-event-api
operations.summary: Enable the Event API of a file data source (asynchronous; blocks snapshot uploads)

operations.name: disable-event-api
operations.summary: Disable the Event API of a file data source

operations.name: send-event
operations.summary: Send one change event to a file data source

fields.name: data
fields.description: Event data keyed by data source schema field names

operations.name: send-events-batch
operations.summary: Send up to 5,000 change events at once (items as in send-event, via --body)

operations.name: send-metrics
operations.summary: Send metrics to a Prometheus API data source (up to 5,000 per request, via --body)

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Metrics (timestamp in epoch ms, value, labels[{name,value}], metadata)

operations.name: enable-groups
operations.summary: Start groups of a univariate time-series anomaly detection app

params.name: servingPipelineId
params.description: App ID shown in the console app detail

fields.name: groupKey
fields.description: Group labels [{name, value[]}]; only when the data source has group labels

operations.name: disable-groups
operations.summary: Stop groups of a univariate time-series anomaly detection app

params.name: servingPipelineId
params.description: App ID shown in the console app detail

fields.name: groupKey
fields.description: Group labels [{name, value[]}]; only when the data source has group labels

operations.name: delete-groups
operations.summary: Delete groups of a univariate time-series anomaly detection app (cannot be undone)

params.name: servingPipelineId
params.description: App ID shown in the console app detail

fields.name: groupKey
fields.description: Group labels [{name, value[]}]; only when the data source has group labels

operations.name: get-recommendations
operations.summary: Request recommendations from a recommendation system app

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Target user ID (empty string for an anonymous user)

fields.name: context
fields.description: currentItemKey, recentlyViewed, availableItems, pageType, sessionId, impressions, interactions, feedback

operations.name: send-recommendation-event
operations.summary: Send a user reaction event (e.g. click) to a recommendation result

fields.name: eventType
fields.description: Event type (e.g. CLICK, PURCHASE), letters/digits/_, up to 64 chars; REQUEST and RESPONSE are reserved

fields.name: requestId
fields.description: body.metadata.requestId of the recommendation response (up to 128 chars)

fields.name: itemKey
fields.description: Recommended item key the user reacted to
